name: Atexxo Zone 1 iPad mini 7
removable: No (permanently converted: flameproof enclosure around the iPad, not to be opened in a hazardous location; bottom cover opened outside the Ex area only for charging and SIM)
summary: The Atexxo Zone 1 iPad mini 7 is a standard iPad mini (A17 Pro) converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It is a flameproof (Ex d) design, and the tablet runs iPadOS 27.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 1 iPad mini 7, front view

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIA T135°C Db
atex.status: ATEX rev. 3 (2025-04-01) and IECEx Current, issue 3 (2025-04-01), checked 2026-10-25

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T4 Gb / Ex tb IIIA T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: CSA 80152658 (NA certificate CSA23CA80152658X; original 2023-06-07 for the mini 6, updated 2025-05-05 to add the mini 7): Canada Ex db IIC T4 Gb; US Class I, Zone 1, AEx db IIC T4 Gb; Ta −20 to +50°C, charging +10 to +45°C. The certificate also allows the marking 'Class I, Division 2, Groups A, B, C & D, T4'. Gas only; no Class II/III (dust) rating.

safety.conditions: ATEX EPS 22 ATEX 1 162 X rev. 3 and IECEx EPS 22.0020X issue 3: Ta −20°C to +50°C. Repair of flameproof joints not allowed (EN/IEC 60079-1 values). Minimum property class of screws A4-70; only original parts from the manufacturer. Glass window to be protected from impact energy above 2 J. Device shall not be opened in a hazardous location; battery charging only outside the hazardous location. Added by CSA 80152658 and INMETRO DNV 25.0026 X (not in the ATEX/IECEx text): SIM card cover and bottom cover opened only outside the hazardous location and kept screwed in place; charging only at +10°C to +45°C (CSA); check the enclosure and corner bumpers for damage before use in a hazardous area (INMETRO).
safety.peripherals: SIM and charging covers must be closed and screwed in place; opened only outside the hazardous area; charging only +10 to +45°C
safety.certifiedAccessories: Shoulder strap for Zone 1 and Zone 2 phones and tablets (Atexxo product). Ex rating not stated separately.

os.name: iPadOS

os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least October 2029 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 8.3-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD, P3, True Tone, fully laminated, antireflective coating
specs.camera: 12 MP Wide, f/1.8, True Tone flash
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi (9 hours cellular)
specs.ports: USB-C (USB 3, 10 Gb/s); magnetic Apple Pencil connector
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.network: Wi-Fi only or Wi-Fi + Cellular (5G sub-6 GHz)
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button with Touch ID sensor, volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C); hover
